title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ("Cross-site Scripting") vulnerability… (CVE-2026-107260)
description: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ("Cross-site Scripting") vulnerability in Drupal Sector Distribution allows Stored XSS. This issue affects Sector Distribution versions: from 0.0.0 to 10.3.3, from 10.4.0 to 10.4.2.
